# Duty Officer
1. Your direct superior is the Head of Security and the Warden.
2. Standard [color=#00a933]Code Green[/color] equipment is:
3. The Duty Officer is allowed to use and wear riot equipment and weaponry on green alert if needed to quell unrest in the brig.
4. Duty Officers are to work alongside the Warden to ensure that prisoners in the brig are provided adequate care, alongside any other tasks the Warden requires aid with.
5. Duty Officers are to ensure that the brig remains a space that is free of mess and hazards.
6. Duty Officers are expected to bring outside crewmembers into the brig to fulfill any requirements the prisoners require, such as the chef delivering food or janitors providing cleaning services.
